question: Herpes in humans is a:
solution:
The correct answer is __**viral disease.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Herpes in humans is a** viral disease. **
 
• There are eight herpes viruses for which humans are the primary host.
 
• They are the herpes** **
 
 
• **simplex virus 1, **
 
• **herpes simplex virus 2, **
 
• **varicella-zoster virus, **
 
• **Epstein-Barr virus, **
 
• **cytomegalovirus, **
 
• **Human herpesvirus-6, **
 
• **Human herpesvirus-7, **
 
• **Kaposi's sarcoma herpes virus.**
 
 
 
• **Other Viral disease:**
 
 
• Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD)
 
• Rabies 
 
• Plague 
 
• Pox 
 
• Influenza
